'''Ancient Overlords''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Ancient Parasites|Ancient]] Tier.

They are one of the Bosses of the mod.

== ''Spawning'' ==
Overlords no longer spawn naturally until their upcoming rework.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Ancient Overlords are Melee and Ranged Tanks. Overlords have a bossbar.

*Overlords' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, inflicting AoE Damage and great Knockback.
*Overlords' Ranged Attack is performed by them shooting an homing projectile.
*Overlords can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 9, with a 5 ticks cooldown and 4 Blocks range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Ancient Overlords, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Overlords have a chance to explode, releasing a large effect cloud of [[Viral]], [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]], and stacking Poison.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Overlords are also known as '''Terla''' in the Mod Files.
*Overlords are inspired by the [https://stephenkingsthemist.fandom.com/wiki/Behemoth Behemoth] from the Mist.
*The [[Haunter]]'s model is derived from the Overlord, likely to have its visual concept implemented before the Overlord is reworked and completely changed.
*The Ancient Overlord's spawn egg denotes the Monumenta branch of [[Advancements]], which is related to slaying [[Nexus]] parasites.
**It shares the same egg texture with the [[Ancient Dreadnaut]].
